content.value_statement: Location features in .NET can require many Azure Maps clients and authentication choices. This skill gives focused setup steps, C# workflows, and production cautions.
actual_capabilities: Shows NuGet package installation commands for Azure Maps .NET SDK components.
Explains subscription key, Entra ID, and SAS authentication patterns.
Provides C# examples for geocoding, reverse geocoding, and boundary polygons.
Provides routing examples for directions, options, route matrix, and route range.
Covers map tile rendering, IP geolocation, and current weather requests.
Lists key SDK types and reference links for further documentation.
limitations: Examples use beta package versions shown in the source and may need updates.
It does not create Azure resources or validate account permissions.
It does not replace production security review for keys, tokens, or billing controls.
Code samples need testing against the target .NET and Azure SDK versions.

use_cases.title: Add Address Search
use_cases.description: Build geocoding and reverse geocoding flows for customer addresses or map search features.

use_cases.title: Plan Routes at Scale
use_cases.description: Use directions, route options, route matrices, and reachable range calculations in backend services.

use_cases.title: Choose Secure Authentication
use_cases.description: Compare subscription keys, Entra ID, and SAS patterns before moving Azure Maps workloads to production.

prompt_templates.title: Start Azure Maps .NET
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to install Azure Maps .NET packages and create a search client with secure authentication.

prompt_templates.title: Geocode Addresses
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add C# geocoding and reverse geocoding guidance for these inputs: [addresses and coordinates].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Route Services
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a .NET route calculation flow with travel mode, traffic data, route matrix, and retry handling.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Azure Maps .NET design for authentication, rate limits, caching, errors, and package selection. Provide risks and improvements.

output_examples.input: Need to geocode customer addresses in a .NET service.
output: Recommended Azure.Maps.Search package and client setup.
Secure authentication choice for the service environment.
Batch geocoding flow with confidence and address handling notes.
Error handling reminders for invalid requests and throttling.

output_examples.input: Need fastest routes and travel-time matrices for delivery planning.
output: Routing client selection and route option checklist.
Guidance on traffic data, travel mode, and route type.
Matrix size guidance for immediate and asynchronous requests.
Caching and retry practices for high-volume workloads.

output_examples.input: Need map tiles, IP geolocation, and weather data in one project.
output: Package list mapped to each Azure Maps feature area.
Client responsibilities for rendering, geolocation, and weather.
Testing notes for credentials, permissions, and output files.

best_practices: Prefer Entra ID for production services when supported by your account setup.
Cache stable geocoding responses and handle service rate limits with backoff.
Validate coordinates, addresses, and travel options before calling Azure Maps APIs.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode subscription keys in source files or prompts.
Do not skip error handling for 400, 401, and 429 responses.
Do not assume beta package APIs stay stable across upgrades.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps build .NET workflows for Azure Maps search, routing, rendering, geolocation, weather, and authentication.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents installation commands and C# usage patterns for users to review.

faq.question: Which authentication method is recommended?
faq.answer: Use Entra ID for production when available. Use subscription keys only with secure secret handling.

faq.question: Can it help with route matrices?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains immediate and async route matrix options and their size limits.

faq.question: Does it cover map rendering?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes map tile and static image rendering clients.

faq.question: Does it validate my Azure account?
faq.answer: No. You must test credentials, permissions, billing, and service availability in your environment.
